hero.title: Hi, I'm Micaela
hero.p1: I'm a psychologist who specialized in Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) because I believe mental health isn't about always feeling fine — it's about learning to live with everything we are, including the parts that hurt.
hero.p2: I work with adolescents and adults virtually, in a space where honesty, warmth, and respect form the foundation of every session.
hero.p3: My goal isn't to give you answers — it's to walk alongside you as you find your own.

0.title: Clinical supervision and group training at PORTLAND

1.title: Training in Contextual and Third-Wave Therapies

act.title: What is ACT therapy?
act.description: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy is a third-generation, evidence-based therapy. Rather than fighting difficult thoughts and emotions, ACT teaches you to relate to them differently — so they no longer stop you from living the life you want.

0.title: Acceptance
0.desc: Learning to make room for difficult thoughts and emotions without struggling against them or letting them take control.

1.title: Cognitive defusion
1.desc: Stepping back from thoughts — observing them as mental events, not absolute truths.

2.title: Present-moment contact
2.desc: Living in the current moment with openness and curiosity, rather than getting stuck in the past or future.

3.title: The observing self
3.desc: Connecting with a part of you that can observe your own thoughts and emotions without identifying with them.

4.title: Values
4.desc: Clarifying what matters most to you in life — those inner compasses that guide your choices.

5.title: Committed action
5.desc: Acting consistently in the direction of your values, even when fear, doubt, or discomfort show up.

act.quote: ACT doesn't promise you'll stop suffering. It gives you tools so that suffering doesn't own your life.
act.blogLink: Read more about ACT on the blog →

0.title: Genuine connection
0.desc: The therapeutic relationship is the engine of change. We work from a foundation of real trust.

1.title: Straight to the point
1.desc: Honest conversations, no unnecessary jargon, focused on what actually matters.

2.title: At your pace
2.desc: Every process is unique. There's no fixed timeline or arbitrary milestones.

1.q: How often do sessions take place?
1.a: We typically start with weekly sessions. Depending on the process, we can shift to biweekly over time.

2.a: Yes, I work with adolescents aged 15 and up. If you're a parent or guardian, we can arrange an initial call to talk before the first session.

3.a: Fees and payment methods are arranged directly. You can message me on WhatsApp for the most current information.

4.q: Do you coordinate with other professionals?
4.a: Yes, when needed I can coordinate with psychiatrists or other health professionals for a comprehensive approach.
